description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the Special Commodity Levy on Fish, Coconut, Black Gram etc., w.e.f. 14.06.2018
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing specific levy rates on various commodities. It represents a regulatory action that modifies existing legal provisions (rescinding a previous order) and establishes new compliance requirements for specific goods. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
